name: Continue
summary: Open-source coding agent (CLI, VS Code, JetBrains) whose repo went read-only after a final 2.0.0 release; no longer actively maintained.
description: **No longer actively maintained.** Per the README, `continuedev/continue` is read-only; the team shipped a final 2.0.0 release of the VS Code extension, CLI (`@continuedev/cli`) and JetBrains plugin (VS Code v2.0.0 on 2026-06-19) that removed anonymous telemetry and pulled out authentication. Docs remain at docs.continue.dev. Listed for reference because it is still widely installed; for maintained open-source alternatives see Cline, Kilo Code or OpenCode.
